images.seen: A couple walking a golden retriever at night through amber sodium fog, haloed streetlights, an art-deco apartment block glowing behind. Friday.
lines: The whole street has gone amber tonight; the fog is holding the light like syrup.
Friday night fog: the block gets quieter, the streetlights get bigger.
The fog moved in an hour ago and the streetlights have doubled in size since.

images.seen: A woman in a fleece walking her dog into thick ground fog — the taut leash disappears into the white and the dog is completely invisible. Tuesday.
lines: The dog is definitely still on the end of that leash. Almost definitely.
The leash goes into the fog and only faith comes back out of it.
Current visibility: one whole dog short of complete.

images.seen: A man in a gown and slippers wheeling his bin down the driveway into heavy fog, garden topiary fading behind him. Friday.
lines: Gown, slippers, thirty metres of visibility: bin day waits for no weather.
The bin run is being flown on instruments this morning.
Walking to the bin is now an expedition.

images.seen: A view over suburban rooftops with fog lying between the houses at golden sunrise, a jacaranda in bloom below, sun breaking through the layer. Wednesday.
lines: The fog is lying in the streets like it pays rates here.
Sun from above, fog from below: the suburb is the middle of the sandwich.
The fog got in among the houses overnight and the sun is evicting it street by street.
